summary: Computes and visualizes the Spearman correlation between electrophysiology and widefield imaging neurometric shift values across 32 defined cortical regions.
use_when: compare electrophysiology and widefield imaging shifts
compute Spearman correlation for cortical neurometric shifts
plot ephys vs wfi neurometric shift with regression
calculate regional neurometric shift correlation between ephys and wfi
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
